cards.title: Empty Nest: The Grief of Letting Go
cards.body: Parents experience continuous grieving as children grow and leave home. One father reflects on his daughters leaving for university and the unexpected emotional toll of 'empty nesting.'

cards.title: Second Baby: Remembering What You Forgot
cards.body: New parents with a second child often discover they've forgotten much about infant care. From feeding to teeth and sleep, the learning curve returns with surprising challenges.

cards.title: Should AI Replace Parental Judgment?
cards.body: Tech companies offer eye-movement trackers and nap predictions, promising to optimize parenting. But does technology solve the real challenges parents face, or just add complexity?

cards.title: Is Parental Power Inherently Disrespectful?
cards.body: Experts question whether exerting parental authority disrespects children's autonomy and individuality. Understanding power dynamics in parenting helps create healthier family relationships.

cards.title: Lessons from Parenting Your Second Child
cards.body: Second-time parenthood reveals unexpected surprises and challenges that first-time parents rarely anticipate. Each child brings unique lessons about flexibility and resilience.

cards.title: Three Options for Disciplining Rule-Breaking Kids
cards.body: Parents have multiple approaches when children and teens break rules. Understanding disciplinary options helps create consistent, fair consequences.

cards.title: Setting Financial Boundaries with Adult Children
cards.body: Saying 'I can't afford it' to adult children rarely enforces boundaries effectively. Better phrases help parents communicate unwillingness without excusing themselves.

cards.title: Five Breastfeeding Facts Every Parent Should Know
cards.body: Breastfeeding research continuously evolves with new findings for parents. Understanding current evidence helps new and expecting parents make informed decisions.

cards.title: Emotional Regulation Prevents Child Aggression
cards.body: Teaching children emotional regulation is critical harm prevention, not just soft skill development. Learning to tolerate difficult feelings helps prevent aggression and self-harm.

cards.title: Salmonella Risk for Vulnerable Groups
cards.body: Under-fives, pregnant women, and over-65s should avoid runny eggs when eating out. The advisory protects vulnerable populations during salmonella outbreaks.

cards.title: Parental Negligence and Criminal Responsibility
cards.body: A Georgia father's sentencing reinforces growing legal precedent holding parents criminally responsible when negligence contributes to minors causing mass harm. The case sets important legal boundaries.
